title: Missing a Connecting Flight
paragraphs: Karena penerbangan pertamanya tertunda, Hadi tiba di gerbang lanjutan tepat saat pintunya ditutup, dan hanya bisa melihat pesawat yang ia butuhkan menjauh dari garbarata tanpa dirinya. Frustrasi namun berusaha tetap tenang, ia berjalan ke meja bantuan maskapai, di mana seorang staf dengan cepat memesankan ulang tiketnya untuk penerbangan berikutnya, berangkat sekitar tiga jam lagi.

Alih-alih membuang waktu untuk mengeluh, Hadi mencari sudut yang tenang, shalat Asar, dan memanfaatkan waktu senggang tak terduga itu untuk membalas beberapa email kerja yang selama ini ia tunda. Ketika akhirnya ia naik penerbangan berikutnya, Hadi merasa aneh-anehnya bersyukur atas penundaan itu, karena memberinya momen ketenangan yang jarang di tengah jadwal perjalanan yang terlalu sibuk.
answerKey: Due to a delayed first flight, Hadi arrived at the connecting gate just as the doors were closing, watching helplessly as the plane he needed pulled away from the jet bridge without him. Frustrated but trying to stay composed, he walked to the airline's help desk, where a staff member quickly rebooked him onto the next available flight, departing in about three hours. Rather than wasting the time complaining, Hadi found a quiet corner, prayed Asr, and used the unexpected break to answer a few work emails he had been postponing all week. When he finally boarded the later flight, Hadi felt oddly grateful for the delay, since it gave him a rare moment of stillness in an otherwise overly busy travel schedule.
